audience: rental businesses that sell rental products through a RentMy storefront

useCases.title: Browse and search rental products
useCases.text: List the categories and the products in one category, or search the catalogue by text. List the featured products of the front page.

useCases.title: Price a rental for chosen dates
useCases.text: Price one rental for given dates and quantity. The cart does not change. Check whether a package product is available for those dates.

useCases.title: Read a product, its variants and add-ons
useCases.text: Get the full details of a product or one of its variants. List the add-on products for the same product.

useCases.title: Build a rental cart for a customer
useCases.text: Add a variant to a new cart for chosen dates, then change quantities, remove items or apply a coupon. Checkout and payment are not part of this server.

useCases.title: Review a cart and the pickup locations
useCases.text: Get the items and totals of one cart by its token. List the pickup locations of the store.
